invariants.rationale: projection is passed to batch.setProjectionMatrix, which likely requires it to be non-null.
width is passed as the width parameter to viewBounds.set, which typically expects non-negative sizes.
height is passed as the height parameter to viewBounds.set, which likely must be non-negative for a bounding rectangle.
viewBounds.set(x, y, width, height) sets the width; after the call it should match the width parameter.
viewBounds.set(x, y, width, height) sets the height; after the call it should match the height parameter.
